claim: Classify the labels of every actual nontrivial coarse stabilizer, identify the entire nontrivial-stabilizer locus with the five nonempty disjoint original labeled fixed loci, and retain exact stabilizer laws without inferring one orbit per label.

obligations.name: Objects
obligations.constructed_input: The original full positive normalizer, its actual action on the literal unlevelled analytic curve, original parity and faithful elementary2 action are the exact objects consumed. The arithmetic classifier uses the same original quaternion/order and primitive representatives.
obligations.justification: The original full positive normalizer, its actual action on the literal unlevelled analytic curve, original parity and faithful elementary2 action are the exact objects consumed. The arithmetic classifier uses the same original quaternion/order and primitive representatives.

obligations.name: Indices
obligations.constructed_input: The main theorem covers every actual coarse point and every positive normalizer with nontrivial parity fixing it. The label theorem covers all15 nonzero original labels. The fixed-locus union and uniqueness cover all five original indices and every point.
obligations.justification: The main theorem covers every actual coarse point and every positive normalizer with nontrivial parity fixing it. The label theorem covers all15 nonzero original labels. The fixed-locus union and uniqueness cover all five original indices and every point.

obligations.name: Domain
obligations.constructed_input: No extra fixed-point or primitive-integrality premise is supplied. The actual coarse fixed point is lifted through its original norm-one orbit and the strict bound is proved at that same upstairs point. Arithmetic support and congruence conditions are constructed by the inherited classifier.
obligations.justification: No extra fixed-point or primitive-integrality premise is supplied. The actual coarse fixed point is lifted through its original norm-one orbit and the strict bound is proved at that same upstairs point. Arithmetic support and congruence conditions are constructed by the inherited classifier.

obligations.name: Coefficients
obligations.constructed_input: Original reduced trace, reduced norm, rational scalar, primitive coordinates and original fiveLabels are retained. The exact odd and dyadic congruences classify possible labels without replacing them by arbitrary names or squareclasses.
obligations.justification: Original reduced trace, reduced norm, rational scalar, primitive coordinates and original fiveLabels are retained. The exact odd and dyadic congruences classify possible labels without replacing them by arbitrary names or squareclasses.

obligations.name: Local conditions
obligations.constructed_input: Nontrivial parity excludes scalar representatives. The actual upper-half-plane fixed-line trace bound is strict, and the arithmetic classifier is applied to that exact inequality for the actual fixed representative.
obligations.justification: Nontrivial parity excludes scalar representatives. The actual upper-half-plane fixed-line trace bound is strict, and the arithmetic classifier is applied to that exact inequality for the actual fixed representative.

obligations.name: Transition maps
obligations.constructed_input: The lifted representative has the same original parity as the input normalizer. Its classified label transfers through that equality, then through parity_word to the original faithful group action. No assumed algebraic or moduli comparison is used.
obligations.justification: The lifted representative has the same original parity as the input normalizer. Its classified label transfers through that equality, then through parity_word to the original faithful group action. No assumed algebraic or moduli comparison is used.

obligations.name: Identity
obligations.constructed_input: The five fixed loci are defined using the literal original labels and same action. Nonemptiness uses the five original points; disjointness and complete stabilizer laws use the previously proved all-point uniqueness of nonzero stabilizers.
obligations.justification: The five fixed loci are defined using the literal original labels and same action. Nonemptiness uses the five original points; disjointness and complete stabilizer laws use the previously proved all-point uniqueness of nonzero stabilizers.

obligations.name: Consumers
obligations.constructed_input: The endpoint classifies all possible nontrivial stabilizer labels and their complete fixed loci. Equal labels have not been shown to imply a single orbit, so neither exactly five branch points nor algebraic PEL/contact identity is claimed.
obligations.justification: The endpoint classifies all possible nontrivial stabilizer labels and their complete fixed loci. Equal labels have not been shown to imply a single orbit, so neither exactly five branch points nor algebraic PEL/contact identity is claimed.

obligations.name: Validation
obligations.constructed_input: All161 inherited source bytes and primary API pins are exact. Arithmetic certificate checks belong to the inherited producer. Structural and audit checks here do not run Lean or replace independent source review and hosted elaboration.
obligations.justification: All161 inherited source bytes and primary API pins are exact. Arithmetic certificate checks belong to the inherited producer. Structural and audit checks here do not run Lean or replace independent source review and hosted elaboration.
